evolution.rule: Consumers must ignore unknown fields and flags; producers must not remove or change the meaning of existing v1 fields.

referenceDsp.onset: half-wave rectified log-spectral flux with running peak normalization
referenceDsp.outputTimeReference: mediaTimeMs is the analysis-window end; audibleTimeMs subtracts outputLatencyMs

fields.name: sequence
fields.meaning: Monotonic frame index in producer order.

fields.name: mediaTimeMs
fields.meaning: Media timeline at the end of the DSP analysis window.

fields.name: loudnessDb
fields.meaning: RMS level relative to the fixed LUFS reference.

fields.name: spectrum
fields.meaning: Smoothed log-spaced 40 Hz-16 kHz band magnitudes normalized to [0,1].

fields.name: onset
fields.meaning: Rectified log-spectral-flux onset strength, broadband and low/mid/high groups.

fields.name: beat/bar/phrase
fields.meaning: Optional phase and next-boundary prediction in audible time.

platformTapRules.android: Tap app-owned decoded PCM before AudioTrack; do not use system Visualizer.
platformTapRules.apple: Tap AVAudioEngine PCM and apply live AVAudioSession.outputLatency route updates.
platformTapRules.drm: Protected content sets live-analysis-unavailable and uses generated assets only.
platformTapRules.web: Run the reference analysis in AudioWorklet; do not use AnalyserNode.
